# PIT `mutations.xml` fixtures

Hand-written to PIT 1.x format; real-run fixture pending (blocked on owner A11 time-box / Story 0.2.2a).

Version assumed: PIT 1.17 (`pitest` 1.17.x). The root element carries `version="1.17.4"`, an attribute real PIT does
not emit; it lets the adapter read a version from the report (otherwise `--pit-version` supplies it). Element names
follow `XMLReportListener` in hcoles/pitest. Generated by a throwaway script; edit the XML directly from now on.

- `full-matrix.xml`: `fullMutationMatrix=true` shape. Mutation 1 is killed by `testAdd` and `testAddNegative`
  (`killingTests`), mutation 2 by `testSub`, mutation 3 survives, mutation 4 is `NO_COVERAGE`.
- `no-full-matrix.xml`: only `<killingTest>`; `<killingTests/>` is empty.
- `unlisted-version.xml`: as `full-matrix.xml` with `version="0.9.1"`, off the allow-list.
- `no-version.xml`: no `version` attribute (exercises the `--pit-version` parameter).

Hostile and malformed inputs live in `../malformed/pit/`.
